subTitle: Questions about plans, scheduling, products, and community impact.

faqs.question: What is included in an on-demand detailing appointment?
faqs.answer: On-demand service includes a full exterior wash and dry, interior vacuum, wipe-down of high-touch surfaces, glass cleaning, and finishing touches. Exact scope can vary by vehicle condition.

faqs.question: How do recurring care plans work?
faqs.answer: Recurring plans reserve regular service windows weekly or monthly. Members receive predictable scheduling, priority options, and discounted add-ons for kits and specialty treatments.

faqs.question: Can I buy products without booking a detailing service?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Products page supports standalone purchases and is ready for third-party checkout/API integration as your store workflow evolves.

faqs.question: Do you support referral tracking and affiliate links?
faqs.answer: The site is referral-ready and can be connected to a backend or third-party platform for full attribution, commission tracking, and payouts.

faqs.question: What areas do you currently serve?
faqs.answer: Our default service area is a 50-mile radius around Pontiac, Michigan, including much of Oakland County and nearby communities. Contact us with your zip code to confirm availability.

faqs.question: How does Divine Drive Detail give back to the community?
faqs.answer: A portion of select services and recurring plans supports local nonprofits and outreach initiatives. We also host periodic community service detail events.
